Make live-e2e branch ownership unique per run

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-1
  description: |-
    Derive the disposable Issue prefix from the run marker so each live acceptance plans a distinct ownership branch, fail preflight when that ref already exists, and retain the marker-to-ref mapping in the report. Seed issue states from a run-scoped fixture and resolve Todo/Done by category before admission and terminal assertions so the live entry point no longer embeds hard-coded state UUID literals.
